title: Miyajima vs Naoshima: Which Island Should You Visit?
verdict: Miyajima for first-timers and culture seekers; Naoshima for contemporary art lovers. Do both if you have 10+ days in Japan.

categories.name: Cultural Attractions
categories.summary: Miyajima's UNESCO Itsukushima Shrine and floating torii gate are universally iconic. Naoshima's art is world-class but requires art appreciation.

categories.name: Art & Museums
categories.summary: Naoshima wins decisively — Chichu Art Museum, Benesse House, Lee Ufan Museum, and Art House Project are among the world's finest contemporary art destinations.

categories.name: Nature & Scenery
categories.summary: Mt. Misen (535m), tidal shrine, wandering deer, and dramatic Inland Sea views put Miyajima well ahead for nature lovers.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Miyajima day trip: ¥2,000–4,000. Naoshima full day: ¥8,000–12,000. Miyajima is significantly more affordable.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: 10-min ferry from Miyajimaguchi vs multi-connection journey to Naoshima. Miyajima is far easier to reach.

categories.name: Overnight Experience
categories.summary: Miyajima is magical after day-trippers leave. Naoshima's Benesse House offers exclusive after-hours museum access. Both are exceptional overnights.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Miyajima's oysters, momiji manju, and seafood restaurants beat Naoshima's limited village dining options.

categories.name: First-Time Japan
categories.summary: Miyajima is universally recommended for first-timers. Naoshima is specialist — better for return visitors with specific art interests.

faq.question: Is Miyajima or Naoshima better for a day trip?
faq.answer: Miyajima is significantly better for day trips — 10-minute ferry, easy logistics, full experience in 4–8 hours. Naoshima requires more planning and at least a full day to see properly.

faq.question: Do I need to like art to enjoy Naoshima?
faq.answer: Yes — Reddit is consistent that Naoshima's appeal is almost entirely built around contemporary art. Non-art-lovers frequently report feeling underwhelmed.

faq.question: Can I combine Miyajima and Naoshima in one trip?
faq.answer: Yes — they're 3–4 hours apart via Hiroshima → Okayama → Naoshima. A western Japan circuit combining both is one of Japan's great travel routes.
